recordingBinding.recordingEdition: 1971 Led Zeppelin IV original studio performance, represented by the official Led Zeppelin IV (Remastered) track
recordingBinding.notes: The cached Genius song record 1061 names Led Zeppelin IV, release date 1971-11-08, and Apple Music track 580708180. Apple Music identifies that track as Stairway to Heaven on Led Zeppelin IV (Remastered), dated 8 November 1971. This binds the target to the album performance, not an exact audio master.

independentSources.role: Officially licensed sheet music; Piano/4 Hands arrangement by Dan Coates, Warner Chappell Music
independentSources.finding: Lists A minor as the original published key and associates the arrangement with Led Zeppelin IV.

independentSources.role: Licensed music publisher; Piano/Voice/Guitar sheet music
independentSources.finding: Lists key Am and describes the piece as performed by Led Zeppelin.

scopeCaveat.role: Alternate licensed leadsheet from the same publisher
scopeCaveat.finding: Lists C major as the original published key. C major is the relative major/key signature related to A minor; this is retained as a notation-scope caveat, not treated as evidence of a different performance tonic.

verificationDecision: Two licensed as-performed sheet references identify A minor as the home key for the album performance. A separate leadsheet labels the relative-major key signature C major. The expected value is the A-minor tonic, not a claim that every section stays in one harmonic center. The current combined benchmark key is unavailable; this reference adds a target but does not pass the application output.
